summary: BGM Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026 reporting receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency letter for non-compliance with the minimum bid price requirement (Rule 5550(a)(2)). The closing bid price of its Class A ordinary shares has been below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. The company has a 180-day compliance period until October 21, 2026 to regain compliance by maintaining a $1.00 closing bid price for at least 10 consecutive business days. Options to cure include a potential reverse stock split. This is a routine regulatory notification regarding continued listing standards, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
